greet: Hello! Welcome to The Grand Table. I can help you make a reservation, check availability, or answer questions about our menu. How can I help?
Hi there! How can I assist you today? I can book a table, check availability, or help with your existing reservation.
Good day! I'm here to help with table bookings and questions about our restaurant. What can I do for you?
goodbye: Thank you for visiting The Grand Table. We look forward to seeing you soon!
Goodbye! If you need anything else, don't hesitate to ask. Have a wonderful day!
Thank you! Your booking is all set. See you soon!

book_table.confirm: Perfect! I've reserved a table for {party_size} on {date} at {time}. Your booking reference is #{ref}. We'll see you then!
book_table.need_date: I'd love to help you book a table! What date were you thinking?
book_table.need_time: Great! What time would you like the table for on {date}?
book_table.need_party_size: How many people will be dining?

cancel_booking.confirm: I've cancelled your reservation for {date} at {time}. We're sorry to see you go — hope to see you another time!
cancel_booking.need_ref: I can cancel that for you. Could you share your booking reference number or the name it was booked under?
cancel_booking.not_found: I couldn't find a booking under that name. Could you double-check the details?

check_availability.available: Great news — we have availability on {date} at {time} for up to {max_party} guests. Would you like to make a reservation?
check_availability.unavailable: Unfortunately we're fully booked on {date} at {time}. We do have availability at {alt_time} — would that work?
check_availability.need_date: When were you hoping to visit?

modify_booking.confirm: I've updated your booking to {party_size} guests on {date} at {time}. All confirmed!
modify_booking.need_ref: I can update your booking. What's your booking reference or the name it's under?
modify_booking.not_found: I couldn't locate that booking. Could you check the details?

ask_menu: We offer a wide range of dishes including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. Our menu changes seasonally — you can view the full menu at our website or ask your server when you arrive.
Our menu features modern European cuisine with plenty of plant-based options. We can accommodate most dietary requirements with advance notice — just mention it when booking!
ask_hours: We're open Monday to Saturday from 12pm to 10pm, and Sunday from 12pm to 8pm. The kitchen stops taking orders 30 minutes before closing.
Our opening hours are: Lunch 12pm–3pm, Dinner 6pm–10pm (Mon–Sat). We're open Sunday 12pm–8pm.
ask_location: We're located at 42 High Street, City Centre, EC1A 1BB. We're a 5-minute walk from the Central Station and there's a public car park two streets away.
You'll find us at 42 High Street — right in the city centre, near the main square. There's plenty of public transport nearby.
out_of_scope: I'm sorry, I can only help with restaurant reservations and information about The Grand Table. Is there anything I can assist you with regarding your visit?
That's a bit outside my expertise! I'm best at helping with bookings, menu questions, and restaurant information. Can I help with any of those?
